The seal lands at ~/.local/share/intent/preflight/<sha>.summary, green by its first line `preflight-linux at <sha>: run_tests.sh rc=0, <N> ok, 0 not ok`; read it, or `bin/int prepush --preflight-covers HEAD`. Then answer devbin-vc's request: the reading is banked as refs/bank/vc/tools/wt-reading.txt (blob de8adb1b1ff0, sha256 0cf1f9765cb4...), the scripts as refs/bank/vc/tools/wt-inventory.sh (66dbbcf2e2da, sha256 c78ed2249ca3...) and wt-pass2.sh (0b0e3fbc1d99, sha256 04d7a0e3548c...); both hardcode Intent's root and vc's scratchpad; give fresh read-only outputs of each, and the cases neither decides: committed banks and their mutants, a linked build target, stash entries of a detached worktree, the plain dirs under tmp/, a process standing in a worktree, a base not on main. Owed after: cc's AT rows for every WP-04 criterion but AC-04.7 (Part A's 04.1 to 04.3 and 04.8 to 04.13, Part B's 04.4 to 04.6), design.md, pending's measured cost; then WP-04's gate. Other machines get it in 3.2.7's cut. (5) THE WORKTREE REMOVALS, a light leg with START and END to molt-vc, on its word that hv has made the ~/Devel Spotlight exclusion, by 0656's step; dc's three newly landed ones join the stale set; FOR hv with molt-vc: does the Spotlight wait cover every removal or only the stale set (vc's interim answer to cc, dc and ic: every removal).
